node.statement: Let (u_pol,h_pol) be the inverse supplied by 1.7.4 for Pi_delta: calU x B_delta^{calH}(J) -> S_delta. Uniqueness of this inverse identifies u_grp with u_pol only after proving that X maps to (u_grp(X),h(X)) is a two-sided inverse of that very Pi_delta with the same source and target (for some h).
